hli heatmaps

MED4: the 23 hli genes and the hli set-level tests next to every reference set, in 29 experiments. Direction is treatment vs control, as stored in the KG (no light flip).

Gene level: 23 hli genes

up down not significant not measured. Rows ordered by Cyanorak CK group. In significant-only tables, a gene absent from the table is not significant (genome background). Hover for log2FC and padj.

Set level: hli and the reference sets

Cell colour = −log10(BH padj), saturating at 6; orange up rows, blue down rows; * padj < 0.05; hatched = fewer than 10 significant genes; gray = not testable or descriptive; dot = more than 30% of measured genes significant in that direction.

Static figures: genes by group, genes by light, sets by group, sets by light.
